summary: EIP-8141 收到把 MAX_VERIFY_GAS 从 10 万提高到 30 万的 PR，依据是 Nethermind 的 DoS 基准和隐私池、后量子签名的实测 gas。另一个 PR 澄清 blob 费用会压低 frame transaction 的 GASPRICE。Marius 和 Ethlabs 同步 Glamsterdam 进展：目标是 11-16 ACDT 前拿到审计报告，规范修改和 Hoodi 都还没定。Versioned Opcodes 编号为 EIP-8488 并开讨论帖。ETHBEAT 上线 CROPS 指南。

items.title: EIPs PR #12644：Update EIP-8141: raise MAX_VERIFY_GAS to 300_000
items.note: 08:58 提交。理由：100k 装不下真实应用需要的验证。Groth16 隐私池在 VERIFY 帧里花 236,285 gas（其中证明校验 216,463），Nethermind 和 ethrex 结果一致到 gas 单位；后量子签名需 94k 到 276k。基准（ethresear.ch 26224）测了 100k 到 500k：在每秒失败 gas 相同时，不同上限对节点的伤害相同，上限只放大单个 peer 能推的量；每个 peer 约 100 笔失败交易/秒时，300k 在本地 builder 硬件上把额外出块延迟控制在 25ms 内。Nethermind 已对自己的内存池默认 300k。PR 与 #12301（这个值是下限还是上限）相互独立。
items.title_en: EIPs PR #12644: Update EIP-8141: raise MAX_VERIFY_GAS to 300_000
items.note_en: Opened at 08:58. The reasoning: 100k leaves out validation that real apps need. A Groth16 privacy pool spends 236,285 gas in its VERIFY frame (216,463 of it on the proof check), with Nethermind and ethrex agreeing to the gas unit; post-quantum signatures cost 94k to 276k. The benchmark (ethresear.ch 26224) measured caps from 100k to 500k: at equal failing gas per second the harm to a node is the same at every cap, and the cap only scales how much one peer can push. At about 100 failing transactions per second per peer, 300k keeps the added block-building delay within 25ms on local builder hardware. Nethermind already defaults to 300k for its own mempool. The PR is independent of #12301 (whether the value is a floor or a maximum).

items.title: EIPs PR #12642：Update EIP-8141: note that the blob fee can lower GASPRICE
items.note: 07:45 提交。费用预算一节说 GASPRICE 不含 blob 费，读起来像 blob 费不会影响它；实际上当 `max_fee` 不够付全部小费时，`max_priority_fee` 取 `required_max_fee` 之后的余额，而 `required_max_fee` 包含 `blob_gas * blob_base_fee`，所以 blob base fee 越高，同一笔交易的 GASPRICE 越低。这是核对 Nethermind 的 frame tx `effectiveGasPrice` 时发现的。
items.title_en: EIPs PR #12642: Update EIP-8141: note that the blob fee can lower GASPRICE
items.note_en: Opened at 07:45. The fee budget section says GASPRICE excludes blob fees, which reads as if blob fees never affect it. In fact, when `max_fee` does not cover the full tip, `max_priority_fee` is what is left after `required_max_fee`, and `required_max_fee` includes `blob_gas * blob_base_fee`, so a higher blob base fee lowers GASPRICE for the same transaction. This was found while checking Nethermind's frame tx `effectiveGasPrice` against the formula.

summary_en: EIP-8141 received a PR raising MAX_VERIFY_GAS from 100k to 300k, based on Nethermind's DoS benchmark and measured gas for privacy pools and post-quantum signatures. Another PR clarifies that blob fees can lower the GASPRICE of a frame transaction. Marius and Ethlabs gave Glamsterdam updates: the goal is to have audit reports before ACDT on 11-16, and neither spec changes nor Hoodi have been decided. Versioned Opcodes became EIP-8488 and got a discussion thread. ETHBEAT launched its CROPS guide.
